semantics.kind: Combinational transition and Moore output logic only; original explicitly excludes state flip-flops.
semantics.encoding: state[i] represents Si; next_state[i] represents destination Si.
semantics.multi_active: OR the destination contributions of every active source state; OR each active source Moore output.
semantics.timing: No clock, reset, initialization, or cycle latency specified or present in interface; outputs follow combinational inputs.

numeric.bit_order: Index 0 is S0 through index 9 is S9.
numeric.zero_state: No active source produces zero next_state and zero outputs.
numeric.operations: Boolean bitwise gates; no arithmetic or signedness.

verification.oracle: Original transition rows replayed independently by iterating active source states and ORing destination bits.
verification.coverage: All 1024 binary state vectors with both input values (2048 cases), covering one-hot, multi-hot, all-zero and all-one.
verification.sampling: Drive combinational inputs, wait 1 ns, compare all outputs using case inequality.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS emitted after all comparisons.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Treat each active state independently and OR contributions, consistent with explicit requirement to respond to multiple states.
Original gives no required X/Z behavior; binary inputs verified exhaustively, gate propagation retained without special handling.
